title: Page 10
content_zh:
专门设立一个皮货小镇，类似于现代的百货公司，不过那是一条街的铺子都卖皮货，然后将名声打出去，吸引对皮货感兴趣的商人前来采买。
如今从不足百人的皮货小镇，已成了上万百姓居住的“谨城”，俨然是各国皮货销售的重城，每年往来谨城的商旅数以百万计，宛如现代的商业大城，只要一提到谨城，大家就会想到皮货制品。
理所当然的，赵若瑾成了当地的“缴税大户”，光她一年所缴的税金就能盖书院、建技艺学校、儿少收容所、老人抚养中心，以及穷人免费医疗所等等，造福全西南。
所以她成了西南百姓眼中的“神”，实至名归，而她也做得很高兴，因为她帮助了很多人，让他们找到活路。
“王妃，你长了年岁口涎也渐长了，见面不唠叨两句就不痛快，都带了几年兵还要你叮嘱，快去看看你家柔儿，当心王爷有了女儿不要娘子了，这两小子和那大小子我带走，今天野营，不用准备我们的饭。”赵永湛也是宠小孩的好父亲，一开口就让两个小外甥乐得大叫，当场在草地上打滚翻跟头。
“你……你们……可恶，一群大小男人欺负我一个弱小女子……”她一定要报复，给他们穿臭衣服。
你……弱小女子？叫妹妹的、叫姊姊的、叫娘的都在心里想，你在开玩笑吗？以你无所不能的精神，一头壮牛也能扳倒吧！
几个大小男子汉看了看手叉腰的茶壶，笑着大手牵小手的走开，谁也没理会她的小气。
临走前，赵永湛低低的在妹妹耳边说了句什么，赵若瑾神情一凝。
见人都走了，没得发泄的赵若瑾只好回府去找地头蛇告状。
“上官静，你不要眼里只有女儿，好歹也抽出空管管你的儿子们，他们都快无法无天了，让人气得想抽几鞭子……”哎呀！她的女儿好萌，萌翻了，萌爆了，小萌娃。
上官清柔六个月大，刚长出两颗小乳牙，生了孪生儿子后原本没打算再生的，但事隔多年又有了，赵若瑾不顾丈夫的反对坚决要生，这才有了粉妆玉琢的小女儿。
“儒嚅……嚅儒……”
会发出声音的小郡主一见到娘亲来了，藕节似的小胖手朝她的方向一伸，流着口水要她抱。
“回来了？”上官静失笑地将怀里的小美人递到妻子手中，抬手轻轻拭去她额上薄汗。
“周定庸那家伙是怎么一回事？好好的一件事交给他居然还没办法弄好，你跟他说年底前再不让我看到成果，我阉了他跟刘三顺一样当太监。”灌溉水圳何等重要，有了它便民多了，不用走得老远地挑水去。
他轻戳小女儿面颊，逗得她咯咯笑。“回头我说说他，不过你要在圳道内铺上石片，再用砂石混着沼泽地黑泥搅拌成泥浆倒在石片上，弄成墙一样的圳道太费时费力，周定庸说工程太浩大了，他求到我跟前，叫我多给他一些时日。”
“他倒是狡猾呀！知道求你，只是你跟他说耽搁不起，明年开春就要灌溉了，没弄好不成，我刚才看到我大哥了，你让他带些兵去帮忙，尽量赶工。”让兵士们活动一下筋骨。
“好，我的王妃越来越美了，像咱们西南的沼泽花，越开越艳丽，美得快压过本王风采。”眼露宠溺的上官静轻搂着妻子，将头枕在她肩颈上，与女儿黑亮大眼相对望。
“呿！都老夫老妻了还哄我开心，再美也美不过妖孽投胎的王爷你，我已经认命了，你不要再提醒我。”一看到这张依旧美得如昔年的俊颜，赵若瑾发现她一天比一天更爱他。

“还调侃本王，要罚。”他作势在生过三个孩子的丰臀上一抹，眼眸转深地看向哺育孩子的前胸。
“孩子在呢！还不安分。”她将女儿托高，捉着她的小手轻拍丈夫的脸，小郡主玩得不亦乐乎。
“孩子不在了就能动手动脚？”他饱含欲望的声音颤得特别低沉，有股诱人的迷醉感。
“那还要看我心情好不好。”她一睐目，风情万种。
“那你现在的心情好或不好？”他小心翼翼的问。
赵若瑾神色略凝，冷不防地问道：“你怎么没告诉我皇上驾崩了？”
他面上看不出一丝情绪。“早就该死了，没必要说。”
自作孽。
“谁上位了？”皇子们也死得差不多了。
皇上……不，该说先皇了，一生有十三个皇子，除却几个小的，十五岁以上的快死光了吧！
先是大皇子，而后是七皇子，接着五皇子、六皇子……最后太子也死了，他一院子的姬妾除了有生育子嗣的妻妾外，全部殉葬。
所以生了一女的赵若瑜逃了一劫，她在三年前想办法离开了京城，带着女儿来投奔她大姊。
可是这位穿越人士大概脑中电路板短路了，居然要和大姊“共侍一夫”，还理直气壮地说两姊妹长得相似，睡谁不是一样，要赵若瑾别小气，她也是走投无路才“委曲求全”。
赵若瑾一气之下就让母亲来领人，隔年徐氏就把有点魔怔的小女儿嫁给一位丧妻多年，身材魁梧的武将为妻，她和太子所生的女儿就由赵家收养，待大了贴一份嫁妆便是。
不过最快活地当是成为曾祖父的赵老侯爷，他这个臭棋篓子终于找到不嫌他臭棋的棋伴，老定国公年岁也大了，就爱下下棋，泡杯君山银针佐棋，两人常有往来。
最后这两位不服老的老人家居然成了“老来伴”，不顾年纪一大把了还相偕出游，只带了几名会点拳脚功夫的下人，发誓要游遍西南每个角落，老侯爷甚至还写信回来向大孙女炫耀，吹墟他有多老而弥坚，腿骨比年轻人还好。
“九皇子。”
“咦，居然是他？！”他若没提，她都想不起有这个人。
上官静意味深长的一笑，“怎么不是他，有我在底下推，他不上位都难。”
十年前他就看中老九，能忍才能成大器。

“原来是你……”想想丈夫的狡猾，她也是笑了。
先帝宾天后，其九子即位，年二十一，年号开明，世称开明帝。
同年，静王自立为西南王，拥有百万兵马，他隅居西南，不与大楚为敌，为大楚守护西南到西北边界。
开明三年，开明帝奉西南王为皇叔，免向朝廷岁贡，税收自给，不用上缴，其妻荣显王妃为超品王妃，见帝后可不下跪，群臣见之跪拜。
开明十六年，西南王退位，他不将王位传给儿子，却给了心爱的女儿，是为史上第一位西南女王。
——全书完
要人命的天气 寄秋
天哪！天哪！这是什么天气，还要不要让人活呀？！
室温三十四度耶！居然高得不开冷气就有可能热到会“爆肉”，整个皮肤都是烫的，有灼烧感。
更可怕的是停电——上午九点到下午五点。
不能活了、不能活了，秋快要崩溃了，没电不是要人命吗？秋身上的肥油滋滋滋地往外滴油。
会要人命吧！秋想。
天气实在太热了，比往年还热，还灼热中带闷，没什么风，地面上的柏油冒出白烟，肉眼可见。
所以秋很怕把车子停在太阳底下太久，因为那是一辆烂车，快不行了，秋担心太阳光会把车子烧熔了。
气象报告说有午后雷阵雨，不过这话听听就算了，常常不准，那雨小得只下两分钟，压根别妄想能降温，雨水一洒后热气直往上冒，反而更热了。
content_en:
Set up a leather goods town, similar to a modern department store, except that all the shops on the street sell leather goods, and then spread the name to attract businessmen who are interested in leather goods to come and buy them.
Nowadays, it has grown from a leather goods town with less than a hundred people to a "Jincheng" where tens of thousands of people live. It has become an important city for the sale of fur goods in various countries. Millions of business travelers travel to and from Jincheng every year. It is like a modern commercial city. When mentioning Jincheng, everyone will think of leather goods products.
Of course, Zhao Ruojin has become a "big tax payer" in the local area. The taxes she pays in a year can build academies, technical schools, children's shelters, elderly care centers, and free medical clinics for the poor, etc., benefiting the entire southwest.
So she became a "god" in the eyes of the people in the southwest, and she deserved it, and she was very happy because she helped many people find a way to survive.
"Princess, you are getting older and your mouth is getting longer. It is not pleasant to meet you without nagging a few words. I have been a soldier for several years and I still want you to tell me to go and see your Rou'er. Be careful that the prince has a daughter and does not want a wife. I will take these two boys and the eldest boy away. We are camping today. There is no need to prepare our meals." Zhao Yongzhan is also a good father who dotes on his children. As soon as he opens his mouth, his two little nephews scream with joy and roll somersaults on the grass.
"You... you... are disgusting. A group of big and small men bullied me, a weak woman..." She must take revenge and give them smelly clothes.
You...weak woman? Those who call me sister, call me sister, and call me mother all think to themselves, are you kidding me? With your omnipotent spirit, you can even bring down a strong bull!
Several men, big and small, looked at the teapot with their hands on their hips, smiled and walked away holding hands with each other. No one paid attention to her stinginess.
Before leaving, Zhao Yongzhan whispered something in his sister's ear, and Zhao Ruojin's expression condensed.
Seeing that everyone was gone, Zhao Ruojin, who had no way to vent, had to go back to her house to complain to the local gangster.
"Shangguan Jing, don't only focus on your daughter. At least you should take some time to take care of your sons. They are almost lawless. It makes people want to be whipped a few times..." Oops! Her daughter is so cute, so cute, so adorable, such a cute little baby.
Shangguan Qingrou was six months old and had just grown two baby teeth. After giving birth to twin boys, she originally had no intention of having twins, but they had twins again after many years. Zhao Ruojin decided to have twins despite her husband's objections, and then they had a pink and beautiful little girl.
"Ru Ru... Ru Ru..."
As soon as the little princess who could make sounds saw her mother coming, she stretched out her little chubby hands in her direction, drooling and asked her to hold her.
"You're back?" Shangguanjing smiled and handed the little beauty in his arms to his wife, raising his hand to gently wipe the sweat from her forehead.
"What's going on with that guy Zhou Dingyong? You can't get a good job done by him. Tell him that if you don't let me see the results before the end of the year, I'll castrate him and become a eunuch like Liu Sanshun." Irrigation is so important. With it, it is much more convenient for people. They don't have to go far to carry water.
He nudged his little daughter's cheek, making her giggle. "I'll talk to him later, but you have to pave the Zhen Road with stone flakes, and then mix the sand and gravel with the black mud from the swamp to make a slurry and pour it on the stone chips. It's too time-consuming and laborious to make the Zhen Road like a wall. Zhou Dingyong said that the project was too huge. He begged me and asked me to give him more time."
"He's really cunning! I'm begging you, but you can't afford to delay. Irrigation will be done in the spring next year. It's not done well. I just saw my elder brother. You asked him to bring some soldiers to help and work as quickly as possible." Let the soldiers stretch their muscles.
"Okay, my princess is getting more and more beautiful. Just like the swamp flowers in our southwest, they bloom more and more gorgeously, and her beauty is almost surpassing the beauty of this king." The doting Shangguan gently hugged his wife, rested his head on her shoulder and neck, and looked at his daughter with big black eyes.
"Hum! We're already an old married couple and you still want to make me happy.No matter how beautiful you are, you are the prince who was reincarnated as a monster. I have already accepted my fate. Please don’t remind me again. "As soon as she saw this handsome face, which was still as beautiful as before, Zhao Ruojin found that she loved him more and more day by day.
“You still make fun of me, and I want to be punished. " He gestured at the plump buttocks where he had given birth to three children, and his eyes turned to look deeply at the chest where he had nursed the children.
"The child is here! Still restless. "She lifted her daughter up, grabbed her little hand and patted her husband's face. The little princess had a great time.
"Can you do anything when the child is gone? "His voice full of desire trembled particularly low, with a seductive sense of intoxication.
“It depends on whether I’m in a good mood or not. "She has a glance and is full of charm.
"So are you in a good or bad mood now? he asked cautiously.
Zhao Ruojin looked slightly condensed and asked coldly: "Why didn't you tell me that the emperor passed away? "
There was no emotion on his face. “He should have died a long time ago, there is no need to say anything. "
Self-inflicted evil.
"Who's in charge? "The princes are almost dead too.
The Emperor... no, let’s talk about the former Emperor. There were thirteen princes in his life. Except for a few younger ones, almost all of them above the age of fifteen are dead!
First the eldest prince, then the seventh prince, then the fifth prince, the sixth prince... Finally the prince also died, and all the concubines in his courtyard were buried except those who gave birth to children.
So Zhao Ruoyu, who gave birth to a daughter, escaped. She found a way to leave the capital three years ago and took her daughter to join her eldest sister.
However, this time traveler probably had a circuit board short-circuit in his brain, and he actually wanted to "serve the same husband" with his eldest sister. He also confidently said that the two sisters looked similar, so whoever they slept with was different. He asked Zhao Ruojin not to be stingy, because she had no choice but to "endure".
Zhao Ruojin was so angry that she asked her mother to take care of her. The next year, the Xu family married their somewhat bewildered little daughter to a burly military general who had been widowed for many years. The daughter she had with the prince was adopted by the Zhao family, and a dowry was given to her when she grew up.
But the happiest person was the great-grandfather, Mr. Zhao. He, a bad chess player, finally found a chess partner who didn't mind his bad chess skills. Old Duke Ding was getting older, so he loved to play chess and made a cup of Junshan Silver Needle to play chess with him. The two of them often interacted with each other.
In the end, these two old people who refused to accept their old age actually became "old companions". Regardless of their age, they still traveled together. They only brought a few servants who knew some martial arts and vowed to travel to every corner of the southwest. The old marquis even wrote a letter back to show off to his eldest granddaughter, bragging about how old and strong he was, and his leg bones were better than those of young people.
"The Ninth Prince. "
"Hey, it's actually him? ! "If he hadn't mentioned it, she wouldn't have remembered this person.
Shangguan Jing smiled meaningfully, "Why isn't it him? With me pushing him from the bottom, it would be difficult for him not to rise to the top. "
Ten years ago, he had taken a fancy to Lao Jiu. Only by being patient can he become a great person.
"So it's you..." Thinking about her husband's cunning, she also smiled.
The late Emperor Bin Tianhou, and his nine sons came to the throne at the age of twenty-one. They were given the reign title Kaiming and were known as Kaiming Emperors in the world.
In the same year, King Jing established himself as the king of the southwest, with millions of soldiers and horses. He lived in the southwest and was not an enemy of Da Chu. He guarded the southwest to northwest borders for Da Chu.
In the third year of Kaiming's reign, Emperor Kaiming appointed King Nannan as his uncle. He was exempted from paying annual tribute to the court and was self-sufficient in taxes. He did not have to pay taxes. His wife, Princess Rongxian, was a super-grade princess. She was not allowed to kneel down when she saw the emperor, but all the ministers knelt down when they saw her.
In the 16th year of the Kaiming Dynasty, the King of the Southwest abdicated. He did not pass the throne to his son, but gave it to his beloved daughter. She became the first Queen of the Southwest in history.
——Complete book
The weather that kills people, send autumn
Oh my gosh! Oh my gosh! What kind of weather is this? Do we still want to let people live? !
The room temperature is thirty-four degrees! It's actually so high that even if you don't turn on the air conditioner, it may be so hot that your flesh will explode. Your whole skin will be hot and have a burning sensation.
Even more frightening was the power outage - from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.
I can't live anymore, I can't live anymore, Qiu is about to collapse, isn't it going to kill people if they don't have power? AutumnThe fat on his body dripped out.
It will kill people! Qiu thought.
The weather was really hot, even hotter than previous years. It was scorching and stuffy. There was no wind, and white smoke was rising from the asphalt on the ground, which was visible to the naked eye.
So Qiu was afraid of parking the car in the sun for too long, because it was a bad car and was about to die. Qiu was worried that the sun would melt the car.
The weather report said there would be thunderstorms in the afternoon, but just listen to this, as it is often inaccurate. The rain was so light that it only fell for two minutes. Don't even think it could cool down the temperature. After the rain fell, the heat rose straight up, making it even hotter.
